'''Fuzzy Wurm Crawler''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Acid Goop
|Intent = Attack1
|Effect = Deals (4;{{Asc2|9|6}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Inhale
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 7 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Repeats a fixed three-turn cycle:
# {{Int2|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler|Acid Goop}}
# {{Int2|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler|Inhale}}
# {{Int2|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler|Acid Goop}}

Then the cycle starts over.

== Notes ==
* {{Int2|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler|Inhale}} grants 7 {{BD2|Strength}}, which greatly increases the damage of the following {{Int2|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler|Acid Goop}}. However, this {{BD2|Strength}} also carries over to future cycles, so each {{Int2|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler|Acid Goop}} hits harder than the last.
* The base damage of {{Int2|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler|Acid Goop}} is low (4), but after the first {{Int2|Fuzzy Wurm Crawler|Inhale}} it deals 11 damage, and it continues to scale with each cycle.
